Bill.BriefDescription: Promoting the purchase of fuel cells for the use of distributive generation at state-owned facilities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to promoting the purchase of fuel cells for the useof distributive generation at stateowned facilities; and adding a newsection to chapter 43.19 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.19 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: State agencies, when planning for the construction of a statefacility, must consider the implementation and utilization of fuel celltechnology as a primary source of energy for a facility that requiresa source of uninterrupted electric power. As used in this section,"fuel cell" means an electrochemical reaction that generateselectricity by combining atoms of hydrogen and oxygen in the presenceof a catalyst. "State facilities" has the same meaning as provided inRCW 43.19.450.
